newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures close mixed.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures close mixed.

text.p: Jan 20 - U.S. stock index futures closed mixed in thin, illiquid trade. March S&Ps scaled off all-time highs to end slightly lower. Some traders said the contract's performance portends losses in the next several days. Fed chairman Greenspan testifies to Congress on Tuesday. Weekly U.S. store sales data also to be released on Tuesday.
